note: Expert code is not in this repository. It lives in the agent above in the Extella market; sha = first 12 hex of sha256 of the code. Versions with in_market=false were used by earlier runs only.

experts.name: cafe_game_plan
experts.description: A Month at the Café: turns the model's short plan for tomorrow (stock and staff lean|normal|safe, purchases, prices, discounts, card choices) and the evening observation into the exact decision: orders, shifts, hires, plus dollar estimates and money warnings.

experts.name: cafe_month
experts.description: A Month at the Café, the whole game in one expert: replays the month so far, shows the current evening, applies a plan through cafe_game_plan and plays the next day; mode=check replays a full 30-evening log and returns the score for the leaderboard.
